about.name: chronomap
about.privacy.clear: To reset preferences, remove chronomap.lang and chronomap.onboarded from localStorage.
about.privacy.coordinates: Location is used in this browser to show the map position and is not sent to a chronomap server.
about.privacy.network: In the current build, tile requests reveal the viewed area to GSI. Konjaku is currently an About-only attribution entry and is not included in the runtime layer registry, so the current build makes no tile requests to ktgis.net. If ADR-006 later authorizes adding it to the runtime, that destination will be disclosed again. While POI is enabled at zoom 13 or higher, the map center is sent to Wikimedia for article search. This app uses no cookies, analytics, or tracking.
about.privacy.outbound: Only after you choose it, a third-party map service opens with the selected coordinates. The destination provider's terms and privacy policy then apply.
about.privacy.serviceWorker: After installation, the app shell may remain in the service worker's persistent browser CacheStorage for offline startup.
about.privacy.storage: The only localStorage keys saved are chronomap.lang and chronomap.onboarded.
